productLoss: Background activity and Text generation model were fully unsupported on Lynxtron but used the same contrast as working General settings, so users could not distinguish unavailable capabilities at a glance.

The shared General row adapters now carry an explicit unavailable state. Lynx marks the two unsupported rows as disabled and muted while Web exports the model capability as available and keeps its working controls unchanged.
The About version row remains available because it still communicates the current version; only its automatic-update sub-capability is unavailable.
harnessMismatch: The first package-level Web test command placed the file filter after a second -- and accidentally broadened to the full Web suite; the owned run was stopped and the focused unit project was invoked directly.

The first Native capture proved the visual result but the verifier only asserted unavailable opacity on Appearance. The final gate addresses General rows by stable semantic ids instead of relying on empty Lynx row innerText.

It is representative Native evidence and is not claimed as matched Web pixel parity.
